question.text: For a Social Enterprise's NON-LISTED project, the Annual Impact Report must be:

answer.text: Assessed by an empanelled SIA on a limited-assurance basis.
Assessed by an empanelled SIA on a reasonable-assurance basis.
Waived if the project spend is below INR 50 lakh.

explanation.text: The Logic: Regulation 91E(2) proviso and 91E(2A) state that AIR for non-listed projects shall be SELF-CERTIFIED by the Social Enterprise. External SIA assessment is mandatory only for listed projects (those linked to the instruments listed on SSE). The Trap: Students often apply the SIA-assessment rule to every AIR line item. The LODR treats the NPO's non-listed work as self-reported (with the SE explaining its methodology for determining significance); only listed projects attract SIA assurance. Cross-Exam Context: XXIII Topic 5 (Assurance) addresses limited vs reasonable assurance; this Topic 9 addresses which projects require external assurance at all. III-A does not discriminate this way. Assessor's Pro-Tip: When engagement-scoping an AIR, ring-fence LISTED vs NON-LISTED projects on page 1 of the engagement letter. The SIA fee and hours should be linked to the listed-project portion only; non-listed project assurance is outside scope unless separately commissioned.
